reason: I forget my vitamins half the time, and a foil sachet in a drawer is just another thing I will forget. Two capsules every day is a chore, and $25 to $30 is a lot to risk on something I will probably skip.
objection: A sachet does not fix my real problem, which is remembering. I will end up with a half-full box and wasted money, and the money-back deal only works if I finish all 30, which I probably will not.
would_change_my_mind: A creator video showing a busy mom with my exact problem (can't sleep, forgets vitamins) using it, plus a one-capsule version or a trial pack of 7 for under $10.
